html:
SMTO-UI-0051 — Server update needs a restart

GUID: 49a4dd64-6b0b-50d3-8fdf-e10989d2a826
Slug: ui-server-restart-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: browser

What happened

  • SMTO was updated, but the server is still running the older version, so memory indexing progress can't be shown yet. Showing this message doesn't change your memories or earlier work.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Before restarting, make sure no important task is running, and copy any text you haven't sent. A restart briefly interrupts running tasks and connections while SMTO saves your workspace.
  2. If you're an administrator, select Restart server in this message. Otherwise, ask your administrator to restart the SMTO server. The update is already installed; it only takes effect after the server restarts.
  3. When SMTO is ready again, go back to the page that showed memory indexing progress, such as Knowledge. The restarted server can now report indexing progress to this page.

What success looks like

  • Memory indexing progress appears normally, without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Open System Health to look for another problem before restarting again, and don't restart repeatedly while tasks are running.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Server update needs a restart.

What this means

  • The installed page feature is newer than the interface loaded by the running server. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported ui_server_restart_required. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • A new server instance reports the indexing-status capability and the status panel loads.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • /api/agent/version/check lists the knowledge.memory_index capability at the required revision in installed_capabilities but not in running_capabilities, so the running Server predates the installed code. After checking for active tasks, an administrator should restart the Server (the panel's Restart server action also restarts configured Gateways), then reopen the indexing status panel.
  • The server needs a restart to load the updated indexing-status feature. An administrator can restart it after reviewing the impact on active work.

Retry and execution caution

  • A new server instance reports the indexing-status capability and the status panel loads.

How to verify the fix

  • A new server instance reports the indexing-status capability and the status panel loads.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
